class: A per-migration round-trip test that steps down to before its migration and back up to head replays every LATER migration, so each new migration adds its up+down cost to every earlier migration's tests: the suite's time grows with the square of the chain, and a fixed CI time cap is crossed by a change that adds migrations without any test getting slower on its own.
mechanism: GC-ICTRACK PR #675 added 0046-0048 (each rebuilds and post-checks the app-role allow-list function). The api job's migration round-trip window (tests 3097-3240: the 0024-0044 round-trip files, e.g. 73 tests in test_migration_0025_strategy_name.py) took 32 min instead of 9 min, and the job was cancelled at its 75-min cap at 92 % with 0 failures.

first_seen.evidence: progress 49 % at 22:58:22Z, 50 % at 23:06:15Z, 51 % at 23:30:07Z (3096 -> 3240 tests); main's last green api run 42461489030 job 128671526525: 49 % 08:19:09Z, 51 % 08:28:14Z and the whole app-test step 33 min (08:07:16Z-08:40:06Z). The rest of this run was ~1.7x slower than main's (runner speed), which the cap also has to absorb.

fix: Stopgap 44863868 (merged in #675): api job cap 75 -> 120 min. Class fix not done: run each migration's full down-to-before-N round trip once per file, not once per test.

detection.note: Nothing measures the round-trip window's growth before CI. Candidate: a test that counts migrations x round-trip tests and fails past a budget, naming the files.

occurrences.evidence: cancelled at 75 min at 92 %, 0 failures; round-trip window 9 -> 32 min after 3 new migrations; re-run cancelled too; passed with the cap at 120 min (merged c3f93087).
